eventsIntro: Phuket's party scene is mostly beach clubs with big-name DJs. The most underground nights are small and announced late: Shelter in Patong, and in Old Town the crews at Courage Bar and the late sessions at Sédo Izikura. For proper jungle raves, go to Koh Phangan: a 1-hour flight to Samui plus a boat. In full-moon week (19 to 23 Jan) it has a party every night.

groups.title: Group · 8–18 Jan
items: Fri 8 Jan: arrive at the Patong villa (check-in from 15:00, about 50 minutes from the airport). Argy at Café del Mar in Kamala from 14:00 (15 minutes by car), or Shelter at Illuzion in Patong from 23:30 (a few minutes away).
Sat 9 Jan: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai, 15:00 to 03:00. Book a driver both ways: about 1 hour from the Patong villa.

Sun 10 to Wed 13 Jan: Phuket days from the Patong villa. Boat days to Phi Phi or Phang Nga Bay (most tours pick you up at the villa), the Sunday Walking Street in Old Town (Sun 10) and the Enthusiast Place open doors (Tue 12). Koh Phangan is for full-moon week (19 to 23 Jan).
Wed 13 Jan: Marco Carola at Café del Mar, 15 minutes from the villa.
Thu 14 Jan: move to the Rawai villa (out of Patong by 11:00, in from 16:00, about 20 minutes' drive).
Fri 15 Jan: an island day from Chalong Pier (7 minutes from the Rawai villa), then Shelter, or whatever the Courage Bar crews (SUB, FAKE PALM, Enthusiast) have on.
Sat 16 Jan: Circoloco, second weekend (about 1 hour 10 from the Rawai villa). Mon 18 Jan: out of the villa by 12:00; the group leaves.

groups.title: Two of you · 19–23 Jan
items: Tue 19 Jan: fly to Koh Samui (the 14:15 flight or earlier), then the boat to Thong Sala. Stay in Ban Tai. Tonight: OXA (moved to Tuesday this week) or the Lighthouse Party.
Wed 20 Jan: Waterfall (expected). Thu 21 Jan: Jungle Experience (expected), with Chill Up as the warm-up.
Fri 22 Jan: the Full Moon Party on Haad Rin. Bring cash and closed shoes, and leave your passport in the safe.
Sat 23 Jan: boat to Samui at 10:30 or 11:00, then the 15:05 flight. You land at 16:05 and reach Circoloco in Natai at about 17:00, for the last weekend. Book this flight now.
Staying in Phuket instead? Enthusiast Place on Tue 19, Shelter and DnB Allstars (Chalong, 22 to 24 Jan) on Fri 22, Circoloco on Sat 23.

groups.title: Solo · 24–26 Jan
items: Base: near the airport in Nai Yang (5 to 10 minutes to the terminal), or a social hostel in Patong if you want company.
Sun 24 Jan: the Sunday Walking Street market in Old Town (16:00 to 22:00), or a beach day.
Mon 25 Jan: last party night. Open on Mondays: Illuzion, BOA and Armania in Patong, and Levitate (to 01:00). Closed: Shelter, Courage Bar and the Café del Mar Club Room.
Tue 26 Jan: check out, leave your bags, lunch at Natural Restaurant or on Nai Yang Beach, then plane spotting or the 13:30 Soi Dog tour. Be at the airport by 15:20 for the 18:20 flight.

eventsFooter.title: Finding the real underground
items: Small parties are posted only 1 to 3 weeks ahead. Look again in late December and every Monday of your trip.
Resident Advisor (ra.co): search Phuket and Koh Phangan. phangan.events also lists Phuket nights (Shelter, Illuzion, BOA, Sédo Izikura), often only a few days ahead.
Telegram: the Phangan Party Guide channel (t.me/s/phanganparty) lists each week's parties.
Instagram: Shelter Phuket, Courage Bar and its crews, Retro Mountain, Unclave and the Lighthouse Party post line-ups first.
Ask DJs and bar staff at Shelter and Courage Bar about after-parties. They spread by word of mouth.

Changed since the first research: Bermudos (once in Rawai) has had no listed party since 10 May 2024, at Shelter in Patong. Niky's Speakeasy in Bang Tao still has an open Google listing (Tue-Sun 20:00-02:00, a review from July 2026), but its website is offline. OXA plays more tech house than techno.

placesIntro: Each place shows how long people usually stay (not the drive), the best time to go and the price. Boat tours compare the island trips, and Piers & ferries lists the boats from each pier. In January the sea on the west coast is calm and clear: the best month for beaches and boat trips.
areasIntro: Tap an area on the map to read about it. The colors match the cards below. The labelled pins are our villas: Patong (8–14 Jan) and Rawai (14–18 Jan).
stayIntro: Our villas are booked: the Patong villa from 8 to 14 Jan, then the Rawai villa from 14 to 18 Jan. Just below is what we paid and each person's share. Add your own bookings so the address is one tap away, even offline. Further down is the villa shortlist from Airbnb and Booking.com, with the full price for 8 guests on 8-18 Jan (checked 17-18 Oct 2026). Our two villas there show what we paid.
moneyIntro: Bring clean USD or EUR 100 notes and change them at a money changer, not at the airport or the hotel. ATMs charge 250 to 350 baht for each withdrawal.

2027-01-08: Arrival: fill in the TDAC before you land. The Patong villa is about 50 minutes from the airport without traffic.
Change only a little money at the airport. Mamy Exchange in Koh Kaew has the best rate (weekdays until 17:00) and is on the way to Patong: about 5 extra minutes of driving plus the stop.
Tonight: Argy at Café del Mar in Kamala (from 14:00, about 15 minutes by car) or Shelter in Patong (from 23:30, a few minutes from the villa).
2027-01-09: Tonight: Circoloco in Natai, 15:00 to 03:00: about 1 hour from the Patong villa without traffic (56 km). Book a driver both ways.
By day: keep it easy before the long night. Patong Beach is about 13 minutes on foot from the villa.
2027-01-10: Sunday: the Sunday Walking Street in Old Town (about 16:00 to 22:00), 25 to 30 minutes from Patong by Grab: dinner from the stalls. The SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed today.
After Circoloco, no early boat today. The group stays in Phuket now that the Patong villa is booked to the 14th; Koh Phangan is for full-moon week (19 to 23 Jan).
2027-01-11: A boat day: Phi Phi and Maya Bay by small-group speedboat. Most tours pick you up at the villa in Patong and include lunch and the park fee. See Places, Boat tours.
2027-01-12: A Phuket day from Patong: Big Buddha (about 25 minutes by car) and Wat Chalong, then Karon Viewpoint and a swim at Kata Noi on the way back.
Tonight: the Enthusiast Place open doors in Thalang, about 25 minutes from the villa.
2027-01-13: A boat day: Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island by big boat with sea-cave canoeing (pickup anywhere in Phuket, back by early evening). See Places, Boat tours.
Tonight: Marco Carola at Café del Mar in Kamala, about 15 minutes from the villa.
2027-01-14: About 20 minutes' drive between the villas. Fill the gap on the way: Karon Viewpoint, a swim at Kata or Nai Harn, the Windmill Viewpoint.
Tonight: dinner at the Rawai Seafood Market, 5 minutes from the villa: buy the fish at a stall, a restaurant cooks it.
2027-01-15: An island day from Chalong Pier, 7 minutes from the villa: Racha Yai and Coral Island by speedboat, or the group's own catamaran. See Places, Boat tours.
Tonight: Shelter in Patong, about 25 minutes by car, or whatever the Courage Bar crews have on.
2027-01-16: Tonight: Circoloco, second weekend: about 1 hour 10 from the Rawai villa without traffic (63 km). Book the driver early.
By day: Nai Harn Beach, about 10 minutes from the villa, is the best swim in the south.
2027-01-17: After Circoloco, a slow day near the villa: a longtail from Rawai Pier (5 minutes) to Coral Island or Koh Bon, or an eFoil lesson at KBA, a short walk from the villa. Sunset at Promthep Cape, 9 minutes away: go early, it fills up.
Sunday: the SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed. Use Lion (Jungceylon, Patong) or Mamy.
2027-01-18: Flying home today: the airport is about 55 minutes from the Rawai villa without traffic (44 km); allow 1 h 15 to 1 h 40, more in late-afternoon traffic.
Going to Koh Phangan? If the group leaves this morning, a Samui flight at 14:15 or earlier still catches the boats. Otherwise go tomorrow.
2027-01-19: To Koh Phangan: fly to Samui at 14:15 or earlier, then the boat to Thong Sala (500 THB with the van from Samui airport). Ban Tai is the best base.
Tonight: OXA (moved to Tuesday this week) or the Lighthouse Party. In Phuket: Enthusiast Place open doors from 19:00.
2027-01-20: Full-moon week: expect Waterfall tonight (not announced yet). Utopia may run too.
By day: Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan (08:30 boat, back 15:30 or 16:30), or an Ang Thong speedboat tour.
2027-01-21: Tonight: Jungle Experience (expected, the night before the Full Moon). Chill Up's Phangan Calling from 20:00 is the warm-up.
2027-01-22: Full Moon Party on Haad Rin: 200 THB cash at the gate, closed shoes, passport in the room safe. Check your boat and flight for tomorrow.
In Phuket instead: Shelter, and DnB Allstars starts in Chalong.
2027-01-23: Back to Phuket for the last Circoloco: boat from Thong Sala at 10:30 or 11:00, the 15:05 flight from Samui, Natai at about 17:00.
If your friend flies home today, check their flight against these times.
2027-01-24: On your own from today: see Info, Your solo days. Share your live location before a night out.
Sunday: the SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed.
A solo boat day: the Khai Islands half day (about 1,100 THB), or a boat from Bang Rong Pier to Koh Yao Noi. Do not book a boat for Tue 26.
2027-01-25: Last party night. Open on Mondays: Illuzion, BOA and Armania in Patong, and Levitate (to 01:00). Shelter, Courage Bar and the Café del Mar Club Room are closed.
Book tomorrow's airport ride today (Grab Advance Booking).
2027-01-26: Flight 18:20: be at the airport by 15:20. Leave Kamala by 14:15, Patong by 13:45 or Nai Yang by 15:00.
Bags: hotel reception, or AIRPORTELs at Exit 2 (06:00 to 24:00, 150 baht per bag).

areasRecommendation: Our bases: the Patong villa (8 to 14 Jan), in a quiet lane about 13 minutes on foot from the beach and Bangla Road, then the Rawai villa (14 to 18 Jan), by Friendship Beach on the south-east coast.

From the Patong villa: Shelter and Bangla Road are a few minutes away, Café del Mar in Kamala about 15 minutes by car. Most boat tours pick you up there. From the Rawai villa: Chalong Pier and Rawai Pier (the island boats) are 5 to 10 minutes away, Promthep Cape and Nai Harn about 10, Patong about 20 to 25. Every card says how far it is from both villas.

For the Circoloco Saturdays (9 and 16 Jan with the group, and 23 Jan), book a driver both ways: Natai is about 1 hour from the Patong villa and 1 hour 10 from the Rawai villa without traffic. Sleeping in Natai is hard on those nights: Baba Beach Club has no rooms on sale for 8 to 27 Jan, Natai House showed no rooms online for 9 and 16 Jan, and Aleenta costs about 45,000 to 52,000 THB per night then.
The two of you: Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, 19 to 23 Jan. From Sat 23 Jan: near the airport in Nai Yang, 35 to 45 minutes from Natai after Circoloco and 5 to 10 minutes from the terminal on flight day.

beforeYouFly.text: Fill in the free TDAC arrival card in the 3 days before you land, only on tdac.immigration.go.th.
Install and set up the must-have apps while your home SIM still gets the SMS codes.
Book the Samui flights for 19 and 23 Jan, and a room in Ban Tai for full-moon week.
Buy party tickets early: the cheaper tiers sell out (Argy: on sale Tue 20 Oct, 18:00 Thai time, 15:00 in Yerevan).
Book the boat days early: small-group and private boats sell out in January.
Leave vapes and e-cigarettes at home: they are illegal in Thailand.
Check your passport: valid at least 6 months after arrival, with a free page.
